verdict.rationale: Zep ingests chat messages, documents, and JSON into a per-user Context Graph through entity and edge extraction. It supports custom entity and edge types, explicit node/edge objects, and hybrid search over edges, nodes, and episodes. Graphiti, the open-source engine behind it, is documented as a temporal knowledge graph with provenance and fact invalidation. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of multi-hop graph traversal or multi-hop question answering, and independent or hands-on corroboration of entity-centric retrieval quality.
